response.query: Which external price series (market-level, regional CPI, commodity prices) will anchor trend controls and how will they be integrated into pass-through estimation?
response.answer: External price series like market-level and regional CPI will anchor trend controls, integrated into pass-through estimation through weighted indices. These indices adjust inflation forecasts based on external price movements.
